newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Italians arrive for ERM meeting on lira.
newsitem.headline: Italians arrive for ERM meeting on lira.

text.p: Italy's representatives on the European Union's monetary committee arrived on Saturday for a special meeting to consider the lira's re-entry into the EU's exchange rate mechanism, signalling the start of the meeting.
Treasury Director Mario Draghi and Pier Luigi Ciocca, number two at the central bank, had no comment to make as they entered the building where the meeting was taking place.
Other officials indicated that the meeting could last late into the evening. Sir Nigel Wicks, chairman of the committee, would only say "We'll see, we'll see."
The lira was thrown out of the exchange rate mechanism (ERM) in 1992 amid massive market speculation.
Membership of the ERM, a grid of trading bands designed to stabilise currencies, is seen as a criterion for joining the EU's single currency in 1999.
